name: date-check
description: Checks the dates and times Claude Code writes into changelogs, logs, release notes and handoffs against the real clock before the write lands: a stamp in the future is refused with the real time, a stale one gets a note.

aheadMinutes.title: Minutes ahead allowed
aheadMinutes.description: A written time more than this many minutes ahead of the clock is refused.

staleMinutes.title: Minutes behind before a note
staleMinutes.description: A written time of today more than this many minutes behind the clock gets a note.

staleDays.title: Days behind before a note
staleDays.description: A written date more than this many days before today gets a note; a new file named for such a day is refused once.

staleNotes.title: Notes on old stamps
staleNotes.description: Tell the agent when a stamp it adds is older than the limits above. Off: only stamps in the future are acted on.

promptClock.title: The clock on every prompt
promptClock.description: Each prompt carries the local weekday, date, time and zone, and how long ago your previous message came, so Claude has the real time instead of a guess. Off: nothing is added to prompts.

fill.title: Fill placeholders
fill.description: Replace ⟦NOW⟧, ⟦DATE⟧, ⟦TIME⟧ and ⟦NOW-ISO⟧ in what Claude writes with the local time as the write lands, so Claude need not type the time. Off: placeholders stay as written.
